text:
maria: Heads-up — Echo Harbor private deploy tonight 02:00–03:00 PT. I'll be primary for control-plane steps. Posting a short preflight checklist; please ack and call out any concerns. @devon @ashley @ops-oncall :eyes:

maria: Preflight checklist (high level):
• 01:30 PT — stage model weights to /mnt/models/echo-harbor/v2
• 01:40 PT — push infra config (ingress + LB) to canary
• 01:50 PT — drain canary nodes & run smoke traffic
• 02:00 PT — cutover LB, shift 10% → 100% over 10m
• 02:30 PT — run post-cutover validation, close window by 03:00
(rollback window: immediate until 02:45) :white_check_mark:

devon: Ack. I can handle weights staging and GPU checks. Planning to rsync weights at 01:20 PT and run `sha256sum` after copy. Will be watching node memory + nvlink.

ashley: Ack. I'll own ingress/cert rotation and tracing dashboards. Quick Q: do we need to rotate the client TLS certs in this window or just reload?

maria: @ashley just reload; certs already pre-staged last week. Only configmap update + `kubectl rollout restart deployment/echo-proxy` (canary).

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby for rollback and k8s issues. Rollback playbook is at: https://company.internal/runbooks/echo-harbor-rollback (TL;DR: helm rollback release echo-harbor --to-revision=2; revert ingress configmap).

samir: I'll run the smoke harness. Use this quick test against canary (01:50 PT):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.echo.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ECHO_KEY' \
  -d '{"prompt":"smoke test: 1+1","max_tokens":5}' | jq -r .choices[0].text
```
Expected output: `2` (or similar). Fail if latency > 800ms or error rate > 1%. Post results to this thread.

maria: Good. For clarity — smoke targets: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 700ms during canary; errors <= 1/1000. If smoke fails, rollback immediately and notify customer.

devon: Weight staging note: copying weights to the GVFS mount will take ~12m for the 9GB shard. I'll start rsync at 01:20 so it's ready before 01:40 config push. Command: `rsync -avz /artifacts/echo/v2/* echo-harbor:/mnt/models/echo-harbor/v2/`

jess: CS on call with the customer. Please ping me before the 02:00 cutover and again at 02:15. Customer asked for a 10m heads-up before traffic hits 100%.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria for 2025-03-15 02:00 PT — canary steps enabled. Auto-notify on failures.

ashley: ACK — I'll monitor tracing and cert reload logs (`kubectl logs -f deployment/echo-proxy-canary`).

ops-oncall: ACK. If anything looks off, I have escalation path to infra lead (pager).

samir: After smoke, I'll post a short table: samples run / errors / median latency. If pass, I trigger the LB shift via `scripts/lb-shift --to 100 --step 10 --wait 600`.

maria: Final ask — please react with :white_check_mark: if you are available for the whole window (01:20–03:00 PT). I'll start drain at 01:50 if all clear.

devon: :white_check_mark:
ashley: :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: :white_check_mark:
samir: :white_check_mark:
jess: :white_check_mark: (CS on call)

maria: Thanks — closing preflight here. Posting a short follow-up at 01:15 with live links and the final runbook snippet.
